notes: Yoast post sitemaps (robots.txt Sitemap: /sitemaps.xml): no per-day archive (any /YYYY/MM/DD/ renders the monthly page), so use the two newest post-sitemap chunks (sm1 covers 2026-09-29..10-25, sm2 09-08..09-29) with no date placeholders; lastmod IS the publication date (verified datePublished==lastmod on 6 sample articles), so the checker's lastmod==date filter is exact: 47/28/45 URLs on 09-30/10-10/10-20.
